connector.name: MeatSpace
connector.registryDescription: Human-in-the-loop for AI agents. Submit choices, get a human decision.
connector.summary: Hosted at meatspace.run over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zmarten account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for the ask_human tool. Optional — get_service_status and provision_api_key require no auth, so a fresh client can connect without credentials and call provision_api_key to mint a token instantly.
